items.title: Building strong safety evaluations

extra.evidence: Recommendations for designing, running, and reporting safety evaluations, based on our own experiences. Safety evaluations inform some of the most consequential decisions we make about an AI model, including whether it’s ready to deploy, which safeguards ship alongside it, and what our next round of safety training and research should focus on. When we say a model is “safer than its predecessor,” we mean that it scored better on a set of evals someone built. But a safety claim is only as sound as the eval behind it, and good ones are hard to build. A safety eval measures a model’s propensity to cause or contribute to harm, whether its response to a request makes harm more or less likely, and how severe that harm would be, rather than measuring specific capabilities. items.title: MACaQ: Fast, Model Agnostic Calibrated Quantization for Low-Precision Weights and Activations
items.summary: Weight-activation quantization can reduce the memory and compute cost of neural-network inference, but recent methods often require expensive optimization and architecture-specific propagation of basis transforms across layers. We introduce MACaQ, an MXFP4 W4A4 post-training quantization method that treats every linear layer independently. MACaQ applies a per-channel scale and a block-Hadamard transform online to each layer's activations, while absorbing the corresponding inverse transforms into its weights. Retaining these transforms online avoids cross-layer dependencies and enables a simple streaming implementation of the quantization process, in which only one layer must reside in memory at a time. To improve over round-to-nearest quantization, we introduce Flip-Refinement, a Hessian-aware coordinate-descent procedure that greedily moves individual FP4 codes to adjacent representable values. Despite executing the activation transforms at inference time, MACaQ adds only 2.3% end-to-end overhead over pure MXFP4 on Qwen3-32B in vLLM. MACaQ reaches lower perplexity than DuQuant++ and MR-GPTQ, and already matches their best perplexity on Llama-3-8B in 11 times less quantization time. We further apply MACaQ without architecture-specific modifications to an image diffusion model, illustrating the generality of its layer-local design and show quantization of a 122B parameter model in 64 minutes, using only 32.5GB GPU RAM. Code is available at https://github.com/huawei-csl/MACaQ .
items.title_zh: MACaQ：模型无关的快速校准量化方法
items.summary_zh: MACaQ是一种MXFP4 W4A4训练后量化方法，通过在线应用通道缩放和块哈达玛变换来减少内存和计算成本。Flip-Refinement方法通过贪婪移动FP4代码来提高量化精度。在Qwen3-32B模型上，MACaQ仅增加2.3%的开销，且在Llama-3-8B上的量化时间比DuQuant++和MR-GPTQ快11倍。

items.title: Actor, Judge, or Teacher? Understanding Decision Models in Long-Horizon Agents
items.summary: Decision models answer a question with a typed output, such as a choice among options with a probability for each, so one model can choose an agent's actions, evaluate actions already taken, or score every action to teach a policy with reinforcement learning. Prior work has studied them mainly as actors, judging their usefulness by how well they act. We ask whether a decision model that acts poorly can still teach well. We compare three decision models and three general LLMs as actors and judges on ALFWorld, and use JEV as a teacher on ALFWorld and WebShop. As actors, all six models are pulled away from a subgoal that must come first by an easier one. As judges that see the whole trajectory, the same models credit the steps toward that subgoal, and asking whether each action helped, rather than whether the task will succeed, separates useful from useless actions. As a teacher, JEV raises a Qwen2.5-1.5B policy over GRPO from 72.8% to 82.9% success on ALFWorld and from 56.8% to 71.4% on WebShop. These results suggest that a poor actor can still teach well, because judging an action after the episode ends reveals the consequences that acting must anticipate. Code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/decision-agents.
items.title_zh: Actor, Judge, or Teacher？理解长时智能体中的决策模型
items.summary_zh: 研究决策模型在长时智能体中的三种角色：Actor、Judge和Teacher。通过在ALFWorld和WebShop上的实验，发现即使作为Actor表现不佳的模型，作为Judge时仍能有效评估动作，作为Teacher时能显著提升策略成功率。JEV作为Teacher在ALFWorld和WebShop上的成功率分别从72.8%提升至82.9%和从56.8%提升至71.4%。

items.title: SO-Arena: Benchmarking the Capability Spectrum and Reliability of System One Models
items.summary: System One models promise fast, general-purpose decision-making without lengthy token generation. However, understanding their capability spectrum and decision reliability requires more than aggregate performance on current benchmarks. Existing evaluations often provide limited insight into the breadth of model capabilities and the reliability of their decisions. We introduce SO-Arena, a benchmark characterizing the capability spectrum and decision reliability of System One models across 11 domains and five capability families. For the capability spectrum, SO-Arena offers evidence-grounded evaluation through reliable sources and manual verification of reference labels against model-visible inputs; fine-grained capability assessment through domain-specific difficulty criteria; and realistic interactive evaluation, where models iteratively execute actions in sandboxes. Reasoning-intensive tasks further enable system one-two comparison. Beyond accuracy, SO-Arena assesses decision reliability through two complementary measures: decision stability under controlled option-set changes and missing-answer recognition when no valid option is available. Evaluations across 21 models reveal that the benefits of scaling and additional reasoning vary substantially across domains. More importantly, strong overall performance does not necessarily imply reliable decision-making: the best-performing System One model ranks only seventh in reliability. Together, these findings highlight the need…
items.title_zh: SO-Arena：系统一模型的能力谱系与可靠性评测
items.summary_zh: SO-Arena是一个评测系统一模型能力谱系和决策可靠性的基准，涵盖11个领域和五个能力家族。通过证据驱动的评估、细粒度能力评估和现实交互评估，发现模型在各个领域的扩展和推理收益差异显著。最强性能的系统一模型在可靠性排名中仅列第七。

items.title: Metal Sandbox: Isolated Execution and Command Scheduling for GPU Coding Agents on Apple Silicon
items.summary: On-device inference requires kernels that make effective use of local accelerators. Efficient training and evaluation of models that generate Apple Metal kernels benefit from native macOS tools and concurrent agent sessions. These sessions alternate between model requests, development commands, and GPU execution, leaving GPU capacity idle for much of a rollout. We present Metal Sandbox, infrastructure that combines restricted per-instance file access, native command execution, and command-level scheduling across interconnected Macs. Each agent retains its workspace and private development environment. Parallel commands can run concurrently, while serial commands share one execution slot per node; eligible waiting commands can migrate to available Macs and return results to the original agent. Integration with Harbor supports task execution, automatic verification, and rollout collection through a common workflow. Controlled experiments on four Mac mini M4 nodes achieve $1.68\times$--$2.05\times$ gains in command throughput under concentrated demand. Sixteen static agent traces give an estimated $2.14\times$ sustained-throughput gain for four sessions per node versus one, assuming continuously replenished sessions and unchanged mean durations. Replaying these measured traces under dynamic scheduling reduces mean tool waiting by 18.8% and batch elapsed time by 22.3%, assuming unchanged phase durations. Metal Sandbox and its Harbor integration are open-source on GitHub.
items.title_zh: Metal Sandbox：Apple Silicon上GPU编码智能体的隔离执行与命令调度
items.summary_zh: Metal Sandbox是一个结合受限文件访问、原生命令执行和跨Mac命令调度的基础设施，优化GPU编码智能体的会话管理。在四台Mac mini M4节点上的实验显示，命令吞吐量提升1.68倍至2.05倍，四会话的持续吞吐量比单会话提升2.14倍，动态调度下工具等待时间减少18.8%。

items.title: Discovering Effective Agent Memory Designs through Program Evolution
items.summary: Program evolution provides a promising approach to discover agent memory designs and study the choices underlying their effectiveness. We introduce MAPE, a framework that evolves whole memory programs from minimal seeds through a standardized lifecycle interface and an iterative diagnosis-proposal loop. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval yield an absolute accuracy gain of up to 12% over manually designed baselines at 35% of the serving cost, with further evaluations supporting transfer across serving backbones and benchmarks. Empirical analyses and ablations identify and validate two recurring design patterns: retaining raw conversations as retrievable evidence preserves details omitted from extracted memories, while composing retrieved evidence according to query intent helps the answering model use it effectively. Transplanting the composition module into five existing memory systems improves accuracy across all five. Beyond these patterns, the search objective shapes where computation goes: optimizing serving cost alongside accuracy shifts computation from LLM-based memory construction to selective processing at query time while retaining competitive accuracy. Together, these findings offer empirical lessons for agent memory design. Code is available at https://github.com/ash-ding/MAPE.
items.title_zh: 通过程序进化发现有效的智能体记忆设计
items.summary_zh: MAPE框架通过迭代诊断-提议循环进化整个记忆程序，在LoCoMo和LongMemEval上实现高达12%的准确率提升，且仅占35%的服务成本。研究发现保留原始对话作为可检索证据和根据查询意图组合检索证据是两个有效的设计模式。将组合模块移植到五个现有记忆系统中，所有系统的准确率均得到提升。

a755882e609e.headline: 开发者构建开源刺绣软件
a755882e609e.body: 开发者构建开源刺绣软件，支持 SVG 转换、可视化编辑和 AI 代理设计。

b9fd564218ef.headline: Anthropic 递交 IPO 申请
b9fd564218ef.body: Anthropic 申请成为上市公司，致力于确保 AI 的益处并缓解其风险。

976c01153eee.body: Google Research 展示了 Antigravity 的 /teamwork 多智能体系统，与人类专家合作解决数学、化学等领域的开放问题。

b75d22b73a0d.headline: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT Wallet
b75d22b73a0d.body: OpenAI 发布了 ChatGPT Wallet，允许 ChatGPT Work、Codex 和 Dots 中的代理在用户批准下完成购买。

8d669d03e730.headline: OpenAI 董事会成员担忧 AI 接管社会
8d669d03e730.body: OpenAI 董事会成员担忧 AI 接管社会可能迫在眉睫，研究人员追踪了从 AI 奖励黑客攻击到潜在人类灭绝的路径。

975b7fa5817e.headline: 微软研究院聚焦第 98 期
975b7fa5817e.body: 本期探讨了微软研究院的最新进展，包括 AI 驱动的通用翻译、31 年数学挑战的突破以及 AI 编码代理的加速。

b572820d2175.headline: DeepSeek 开放全家桶应用 API
b572820d2175.body: DeepSeek 正式开放全家桶应用 API，将联网搜索、深度思考、文件输入等能力整合进原有 API，开发者可调用相关功能。

add97d367de3.headline: llama.cpp 发布 v1.0.0 版本
add97d367de3.body: llama.cpp v1.0.0 移除了废弃的公共 API，并添加了 OCP FP8 KV caches、host-memory MoE expert cache 等新功能。

9b62cc4a39e3.headline: transformers 发布 v5.23.0 版本
9b62cc4a39e3.body: transformers v5.23.0 新增了 Inkling 2 Small 多模态模型，该模型接受文本和图像输入并生成文本输出。

203278e26833.body: a2ui-project/a2ui 是开源生成式 UI 框架，支持多平台原生组件渲染。

4369998f7325.headline: MACaQ 提出模型无关的快速校准量化方法
4369998f7325.body: MACaQ 是一种 MXFP4 W4A4 训练后量化方法，通过在线应用通道缩放和块哈达玛变换来减少内存和计算成本。

23fa06e2eaf6.body: Actor, Judge, or Teacher 研究决策模型在长时智能体中的三种角色：Actor、Judge和Teacher。

8e5ec9289aa0.headline: Metal Sandbox优化GPU编码智能体会话管理
8e5ec9289aa0.body: Metal Sandbox结合受限文件访问和原生命令执行，优化GPU编码智能体的会话管理，提升命令吞吐量。

22e28970792f.headline: MAPE框架通过程序进化发现有效智能体记忆设计
22e28970792f.body: MAPE框架通过迭代诊断-提议循环进化整个记忆程序，在LoCoMo和LongMemEval上实现高达12%的准确率提升。
